traduccion: No consigo recordar el nombre de la persona con la que me vi ayer. traduccion_en: I can't remember the name of the person I met yesterday. It's odd, because I remember their face perfectly. Could it be that the names you thought impossible to forget are precisely the ones that won't come? I was thinking about other things without paying it any mind and, when evening came, it came to me all at once. I wonder whether the head gives you the answer just when you stop looking for it. From now on, shall I try to stop straining to remember?
